To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have found a new class of hierarchies of integrable PDEs, which are constrained KP hierarches, which interpolate between the multi‐boson Toda and the generalized non‐Linear Schrodinger hierarchies, which are related by similarity‐Backlund transformation, which are connected to an affine sl(n+ 1) algebraic structure, and which have an interpretation in terms of linear eigenvalue problem on the hermitian symmetric spaces.

the basic constrained KP is equivalent to a linear matrix problem on a hermitian symmetric domain and it is the generalized non‐nonlinear Schrodinger hierarchy; the multi‐boson Toda hierarchy is a constrained KP hierarchy that interpolates between generalized nonlinear Schrodinger and multi‐bosonic KP‐Toda hierarchy; this hierarchy is the result of a Backlund transformation applied to the basic constrained KP.

the basic constrained KP hierarchy can be viewed as a matrix generalization of GNLS hierarchy, and the constrained KP hierarches are obtained by applying the similarity‐Backlund transformation on the basic constrained KP and they are connected to the multi‐boson Toda hierarchies.
